purpose: Data-only index to first-party built-in skill recipes; the skill catalog is the invocation owner.

shared.appearance: Capture the originating user's normalized selected appearance synchronously at generation start; persist the captured standard and appearance with the output. Honor explicit design instructions and output reduced-motion choice. If the owner is not ready, report appearance unavailable rather than use another account's state.
shared.source: Create an editable semantic source with stable object identities and retain its resource revision; preserve unrelated user edits.
shared.checkpoints: Save progressively usable revisions through the existing resource/job owner and label incomplete work honestly.
shared.missingFacts: Ask for essential missing facts when needed; otherwise mark unknown facts as explicit placeholders, never invent them.
shared.provenance: Retain source, asset and factual provenance and the captured appearance revision; do not embed credentials, account IDs or private host paths.
shared.verification: Perform one bounded check appropriate to the requested output and disclose what remains unverified.
shared.authority: The user chooses the existing model and workflow; this record does not activate models, tools, external services or token-saving transforms.

recipes.editableSource: Structured document or editable text resource
recipes.check: Read back headings, text and one representative page.

recipes.editableSource: Workbook model with stable cells, formulas and data relationships
recipes.check: Read back a representative formula, value and source cell.

recipes.editableSource: Deck source with stable slide and object identities
recipes.check: Read back representative slide content and object placement.

recipes.editableSource: Original HTML, CSS and semantic data
recipes.check: Inspect one relevant interaction and the captured appearance.

recipes.editableSource: Editable vector source or original image and source provenance
recipes.check: Inspect the requested subject and one representative detail.
